verses.en: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
verses.pt: Guarda-me, ó Deus; porque eu confio em ti.
verses.en_web: Preserve me, God, for in you do I take refuge.
verses.en_bbe: <Michtam. Of David.> Keep me safe, O God: for in you I have put my faith.

verses.en: O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
verses.pt: Tu, minha alma, disseste ao SENHOR: Tu és meu Senhor; minha bondade não chega até ti.
verses.en_web: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
verses.en_bbe: O my soul, you have said to the Lord, You are my Lord: I have no good but you.

verses.en: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
verses.pt: Mas aos santos que estão na terra, e a os ilustres, nos quais está todo o meu prazer.
verses.en_web: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
verses.en_bbe: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the noble in whom is all my delight.

verses.en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
verses.pt: As dores se multiplicarão daqueles que se apressam para servir a outros deuses; eu não oferecerei seus sacrifícios de derramamento de sangue, e não tomarei seus nomes em meus lábios.
verses.en_web: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
verses.en_bbe: Their sorrows will be increased who go after another god: I will not take drink offerings from their hands, or take their names on my lips.

verses.en: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é a porção da minha herança e o meu cálice; tu sustentas a minha sorte.
verses.en_web: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is my heritage and the wine of my cup; you are the supporter of my right.

verses.en: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.pt: Em lugares agradáveis foram postos os limites do meu terreno; sim, eu recebo uma bela propriedade.
verses.en_web: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: Fair are the places marked out for me; I have a noble heritage.

verses.en: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
verses.pt: Eu louvarei ao SENHOR, que me aconselhou; até de noite meus sentimentos me ensinam.
verses.en_web: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
verses.en_bbe: I will give praise to the Lord who has been my guide; knowledge comes to me from my thoughts in the night.

verses.en: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.pt: Ponho ao SENHOR continuamente diante de mim; porque ele está à minha direita; nunca serei abalado.
verses.en_web: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.en_bbe: I have put the Lord before me at all times; because he is at my right hand, I will not be moved.

verses.en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
verses.pt: Por isso meu coração está contente, e minha glória se alegra; certamente minha carne habitará em segurança.
verses.en_web: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
verses.en_bbe: Because of this my heart is glad, and my glory is full of joy: while my flesh takes its rest in hope.

verses.en: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.pt: Porque tu não deixarás a minha alma no Xeol, nem permitirás que teu Santo veja a degradação.
verses.en_web: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
verses.en_bbe: For you will not let my soul be prisoned in the underworld; you will not let your loved one see the place of death.

verses.en: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
verses.pt: Tu me farás conhecer o caminho da vida; fartura de alegrias há em tua presença; agrados estão em tua mão direita para sempre. Oração de Davi:
verses.en_web: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
verses.en_bbe: You will make clear to me the way of life; where you are joy is complete; in your right hand there are pleasures for ever and ever.
